record.title: Recover the stock entitlement installer boundary
record.intent: Identify the smallest ordinary stock installer and query path that can be tested with specimen-derived guest state.
requirements: Commit tasking before execution. Work offline from preserved specimen applications and logical files; verify exact hashes against official .26 before reusing prior analysis.

Statically recover the ordinary installer and option-query entry points, argument and result semantics, option identifiers, persistence paths, identity dependencies and call order. Distinguish observed stock behavior from prior community references and unknowns.
Identify the required initializers and smallest faithful invocation boundary. Do not substitute success for uninitialized services or assume installer persistence merely from a parser return value.
Preserve private keys, identifiers and proprietary bytes outside tracked source. Publish only a redacted interface/dependency record with reproducible provenance and explicit limits.
No physical instrument contact or mutation, no stock binary changes, and no model/capability redirect in this task. Separate ordinary entitlement handling from the later D-capability experiment.
acceptance: A bounded installer/query contract and guest-baseline requirements or precise unresolved dependency are recorded.
